mula-mutha-bund-garden-c1875.jpg.why_this_image: The Mula-Mutha at Bund Garden, the same reach CPCB station 2192 samples at Mundhawa Bridge downstream. The weir in frame is the Bund Garden bund, built to hold a pool on a river that ran seasonally - which is the story's opening argument in one photograph.

poona-1911-map.jpg.why_this_image: The city thirty-one years after Khadakwasla was completed and fifty years before Panshet failed. The Mula and the Mutha meet at the Sangam near the top of the sheet; almost everything PMC now supplies is off the edge of it.
